node_kinds.name: PoC_Vault_Container
node_kinds.description: A collected vault container whose accounts may correspond to directory users.

node_kinds.name: PoC_Vault_Account
node_kinds.description: A collected account containing a directory user SID.

node_kinds.name: PoC_Vault_Base
node_kinds.description: The custom source kind attached to collected vault objects. It is separate from native AD Base.

node_kinds.name: PoC_Vault_Helper
node_kinds.description: A calculated summary of the collected vault, published atomically with calculated account identity relationships.

relationship_kinds.name: PoC_Vault_ContainsAccount
relationship_kinds.description: Collected evidence that a vault contains an account.

relationship_kinds.name: PoC_Vault_HasAccountFor
relationship_kinds.description: Calculated association with a directory user whose SID matches an account contained in this vault.
